hero_eyebrow: Part P Certified — Emergency Callouts Available
hero_subhead: Faulty socket or flickering lights in Newcastle? We arrive same day, diagnose the fault, and get the power back on safely.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full house rewires, we handle all domestic and light commercial electrical work with safety at the core.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Trips, blown fuses, dead circuits—we diagnose and fix common faults fast. Most callouts resolved same day, with parts carried on the van.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Older wiring puts you at risk. We replace outdated cables, upgrade your consumer unit, and test everything to current Building Regulations.

services.title: New Circuits & Socket Installation
services.desc: Need extra sockets in the kitchen or power for a new appliance? We install new circuits safely and test to ensure long-term reliability.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Controls
services.desc: We install and repair electrical components in heating systems, including thermostats and pump switches, keeping your home warm and efficient.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse boxes are a fire risk. We replace them with modern, safer consumer units that meet the latest safety standards.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Persistent electrical niggles? We locate hidden faults using professional test equipment and put together a plan to fix them properly.

about_pullquote: I started H&B because I hated seeing cowboy electricians rip customers off.
about_para_1: H&B Electrical Services was founded in 2007 by two Newcastle electricians determined to offer honest, reliable work at fair prices. Since then, we've built a solid reputation across Tyne and Wear, completing over 1,200 jobs for homeowners and small businesses. We're Part P certified and regularly attend updates to stay current with Building Regulations and safety standards.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we turn up on time, explain what needs doing, and charge what we quote—no surprises. We carry common spare parts so we can often finish jobs in one visit, saving you hassle and expense. Many of our clients have been with us for years, and we're proud of the word-of-mouth referrals we receive every month.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About H&B

reviews.text: Our electrics were playing up for months before we called H&B. Mark came out, found a dodgy connection in the consumer unit, and sorted it in an hour. Fair price, no faffing about. Really impressed.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had a complete rewire done last year. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished on time. 18 months on, everything still works perfectly. Would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Called them on a Saturday morning when our kitchen went dark. Within 45 minutes someone was at the door, found a blown circuit, and had us back on. That kind of service is worth every penny.
reviews.author: Paul W.
